crystalSources: Awakening Battle score milestones: 1k/3k points → 2 crystals; 4k/5k/6k → 3 crystals
Season Shop: 25,000 Oath Coins each, max 5 per character

chaliceRoute: Craft the gold (Natural Unique) Chalice first — its natural drop is gated behind Transcendence Stage 10.
Lock your core rotation skill on the crafted Chalice (e.g. Gladiator Overhead Slam); skill rolls are otherwise ~1-in-18.
Only enhance gold cards whose 4 skill lines are 3–4 of your build's skills — each enhancement upgrades ONE existing line at random, and no pity system is documented.
Equip mismatched gold cards for their 2-piece/4-piece set bonuses and bank materials for better cards.
Mix sets freely: 2-piece and 4-piece bonuses stack across sets.
statPriority: Positional amps (Frontal for Templar/Gladiator, Rear for Assassin/Ranger) when your uptime supports them
caveats: Most numbers were verified on KR/TW-era systems and may differ on Global until patch parity is confirmed.
Card farming is gated: Transcendence dungeons require Lv 45 + 2,200 Gear Score.
Community routing is unanimous: 'gold grail (Chalice) first'.
